headline: July wholesale revenue hits record high; could surpass last year's full-year record as early as September | Industry
summary: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs reported July wholesale revenue of NT$1.7573 trillion, a record monthly high. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NT$10.7905 trillion.
why: Wholesale sales are a key gauge of domestic trade activity, and Taiwan's trade data is closely watched given its large export and technology sectors.
